Select several tasks with **Ctrl-click**, then **right-click** to change them together.

![Multi-selection and bulk actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omatasks/v1.1.0/screenshots/multi-selection.png)

## Multi-selection and task menu

- **Ctrl-click** toggles tasks, **Ctrl+A** selects all tasks in the current filtered view, and **Escape** clears the selection. Selected tasks are highlighted, including repeated appearances in label groups.
- **Right-click** a selected task or choose **Actions…** to work on the selection. Right-clicking an unselected task targets that task alone. A single task also offers **Edit**.
- Complete tasks; choose Today, Tomorrow, Weekend, Next Monday, or a custom date/recurrence; remove dates; set priorities and deadlines; add reminders; move to a project or section; duplicate; copy task links; or delete with confirmation.
- Quick date choices retain existing recurrence and time. Duplication includes active subtasks and task properties, without comments or reminders. Parent/subtask selections are processed together for completion, moves, duplication, and deletion.
- Bulk requests run in batches of up to 100 commands. **Retry remaining changes** skips confirmed changes and reuses command IDs for uncertain results. Recurring completion advances to the next occurrence.

## Validation

58 JavaScript tests and 17 offscreen QML checks passed, alongside QML parsing, shell syntax checks, and Omarchy plugin validation. Interaction checks cover selection, context menus, retries, deletion confirmation, short panels, and existing drag behavior. Tests and screenshots use sample data; API tests intercept requests without modifying a Todoist account.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omatasks.git --enable
```

Requires Omarchy Quattro and a Todoist account. Existing users can update the plugin through Omarchy.

OmaTasks is an independent project, not created by, affiliated with, or supported by Todoist.
